product_metadata.title: obbsie 6pcs Artificial Eucalyptus Leaves Grass Stems 27.5" Artificial Spring Greenery Stems Plants Fake Eucalyptus Plant Branches for Flower Arrangement Bouquets Floral Vase Wedding Decor
features: 🌿 Package & Size: Each artificial eucalyptus stems are about 27.5" x 9.5", 6pcs artificial greenery stems per pack, artificial leaves branches can be adapted to different sizes of vases to meet your various needs styling needs.

🌿 Flexible Material: Artificial eucalyptus stems plants are made of iron wire, and leaves are made of silk cloth; The branches can be twisted into any shape required, and you can twist them to adjust to the suitable height. Artificial eucalyptus branches can be trimmed to any size with scissors or pliers.

🌿 Natural Look: These faux eucalyptus branches for vases look full and dense, the leaves are so clearly textured. The green color brings you a good mood and makes your home full of life. You can combine with other artificial plants to create many lovely bouquets

🌿 No Maintenance, UV Resistant: Artificial greenery branches stems are UV resistant and never fade. Without worrying about being damaged by the heat of the sun. Dust from long-term use can be washed with water, artificial floral stems is very suitable for people who like plants but have no time to take care of them.

🌿 Multiple Uses: The lifelike faux eucalyptus stems are perfect for interior decoration, front porch, sidewalk, patio, front yard, garden, planter, window, balcony, restaurant, garden, office, hotel, wedding and more. Faux greenery stems will add an extra vibrancy and natural touch to your home, bring a touch of green into your life.
🌿 Notes: The Artificial Eucalyptus Leaves Grass may be squeezed and deformed in transit. It is recommended to use a hair dryer or iron to restore it
